scope: Numerical and import verification of the supplied public IFC model only. No biosafety field validation or CFD validation.

tests.name: Downloaded architecture parses as 21 IFC spaces and 14 doors
Source geometry normalized to SI meters with hash and original GUIDs
All meshes have finite vertices and valid triangle indices
Door graph uses source semantic endpoints; unresolved links excluded
Balanced supply/exhaust yields zero room pressure
Public-model network converges and conserves airflow
Synthetic normal pressures negative and severe exhaust loss reverses target
Reversal metric counts sample-aligned duration without a phantom last interval
Every generated time sample has finite pressure and small flow residual
Sensor CSV accepts valid time, GUID and pressure
CSV rejects unknown GUID, empty pressure, NaN and duplicate timestamp/room
Malformed and wrong-unit model package rejected
